### Psychologie appliquée

[appliedPsychology.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/appliedPsychology/appliedPsychology.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les preuves psychologiques éclairent l'éducation, le travail, la santé et les communautés.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue si un programme communautaire a produit un changement de comportement mesurable.

[environmentalBehaviorChange.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/appliedPsychology/communityMediaAndEnvironment/skills/environmentalBehaviorChange.data.ts)

[socialNormsInCommunities.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/appliedPsychology/communityMediaAndEnvironment/skills/socialNormsInCommunities.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue ce que les gens font habituellement de ce que les autres attendent d'eux.

[humanFactorsAndUserResearch.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/appliedPsychology/humanFactorsAndUserResearch/humanFactorsAndUserResearch.data.ts)

### Attention et conscience

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[attentionAndConsciousness.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/attentionAndConsciousness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Not all available information receives equal processing or enters reportable awareness. Focus, automaticity, waking states, and sleep have related but distinct psychological mechanisms.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l'attention, la conscience et le sommeil influencent le traitement mental de l'information.

Skills: 5

[attentionAllocation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/attentionAllocation/attentionAllocation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Competing demands determine which inputs or tasks are prioritized and when performance degrades.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l'attention privilégie certaines informations face à des sollicitations concurrentes.

[attentionalCapture.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/attentionAllocation/skills/attentionalCapture.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why salient, novel, or personally relevant cues can involuntarily redirect focus.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand un indice nouveau ou frappant attire automatiquement l'attention.

##### Attention partagée

[dividedAttention.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/attentionAllocation/skills/dividedAttention.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze performance costs when simultaneous activities compete for limited processing resources.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi accomplir deux tâches exigeantes en même temps peut réduire les performances.

**Methodological description (English):** Describe failing to notice an unexpected event while engaged in a demanding task.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi une personne concentrée peut manquer un événement visible inattendu.

[selectiveAttention.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/attentionAllocation/skills/selectiveAttention.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain priority given to task-relevant information amid competing signals.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment une personne se concentre sur les informations pertinentes malgré les distractions.

##### Attention soutenue

[sustainedAttention.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/attentionAllocation/skills/sustainedAttention.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain changes in vigilance over extended periods of cognitive effort.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la concentration et la vigilance changent pendant les tâches prolongées.

Skills: 4

[awarenessAndAutomaticity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/awarenessAndAutomaticity/awarenessAndAutomaticity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Deliberate processing differs from practiced routines, and retrospective introspection is an imperfect account of causes.

[alteredStatesOfConsciousness.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/awarenessAndAutomaticity/skills/alteredStatesOfConsciousness.data.ts)

[effortfulAndAutomaticProcessing.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/awarenessAndAutomaticity/skills/effortfulAndAutomaticProcessing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare deliberately controlled thought with processing that occurs with reduced attentional demand.

[skillAutomaticity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/awarenessAndAutomaticity/skills/skillAutomaticity.data.ts)

Skills: 4

[sleepAndDailyRhythms.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/sleepAndDailyRhythms/sleepAndDailyRhythms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Circadian timing and sleep states influence subsequent cognitive functioning, distinct from clinical sleep diagnosis.

[circadianTiming.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/attentionAndConsciousness/sleepAndDailyRhythms/skills/circadianTiming.data.ts)

### Bases biologiques du comportement

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Neural, endocrine, genetic, and evolved processes influence experience and action through interaction with environments. This field emphasizes explanatory mechanisms rather than rote anatomical detail or biological determinism.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment le cerveau, les hormones, les caractères hérités et l’environnement influencent le comportement.

#### Différences biologiques et contexte

Skills: 4

[biologicalDifferencesAndContext.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/biologicalDifferencesAndContext/biologicalDifferencesAndContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inherited characteristics, hormones, and environmental exposures jointly shape outcomes, without fixing a person's future.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l’hérédité, les hormones et l’environnement façonnent ensemble le comportement.

##### Interaction entre gènes et environnement

[geneEnvironmentInteraction.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/biologicalDifferencesAndContext/skills/geneEnvironmentInteraction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why an inherited predisposition can have different behavioral consequences in different surroundings.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi une prédisposition génétique peut avoir des effets différents selon le milieu.

[heritabilityInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/biologicalDifferencesAndContext/skills/heritabilityInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish statistical variation within a studied population from a fixed percentage of one individual's trait attributed to genes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi l’héritabilité est une statistique de population, pas un pourcentage individuel.

##### Influences hormonales

[hormonalInfluences.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/biologicalDifferencesAndContext/skills/hormonalInfluences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how endocrine signals can change arousal or behavior without implying that their effects are universal or direct.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment les hormones influencent l’activation et le comportement selon le contexte.

##### Réponses physiologiques au stress

[physiologicalStressResponses.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/biologicalDifferencesAndContext/skills/physiologicalStressResponses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate autonomic and hormonal changes to perceived demands and subsequent recovery.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment le corps réagit aux exigences puis revient progressivement à l’équilibre.

Skills: 5

[brainBehaviorRelationships.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/brainBehaviorRelationships/brainBehaviorRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distributed neural systems support specific psychological functions; brain scans and localized damage require cautious interpretation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment des systèmes cérébraux en interaction soutiennent différents comportements.

[executiveControlNetworks.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/brainBehaviorRelationships/skills/executiveControlNetworks.data.ts)

[functionalSpecialization.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/brainBehaviorRelationships/skills/functionalSpecialization.data.ts)

[motorNeuralPathways.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/brainBehaviorRelationships/skills/motorNeuralPathways.data.ts)

[sensoryNeuralPathways.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/brainBehaviorRelationships/skills/sensoryNeuralPathways.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate incoming bodily signals to coordinated processing that supports detection and response.

[evolutionaryAccounts.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/evolutionaryAccounts/evolutionaryAccounts.data.ts)

##### Évaluation des affirmations évolutionnistes

[evaluatingEvolutionaryClaims.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/evolutionaryAccounts/skills/evaluatingEvolutionaryClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess behavioral adaptation hypotheses against comparative evidence and plausible developmental or cultural alternatives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évalue les explications évolutionnistes à partir de preuves, et non d’histoires simplement plausibles.

##### Sélection et variation comportementale

[selectionAndBehavioralVariation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/evolutionaryAccounts/skills/selectionAndBehavioralVariation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how inherited variation and differential reproduction could change behavioral predispositions across generations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment des tendances comportementales héréditaires peuvent évoluer au fil des générations.

#### Communication neuronale

Skills: 5

[neuralCommunication.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/neuralCommunication/neuralCommunication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Communication within nervous systems depends on electrical signals, chemical modulation, and changing connections that relate to behavioral functions.

[neuralExcitation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/neuralCommunication/skills/neuralExcitation.data.ts)

[neuralPlasticity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/neuralCommunication/skills/neuralPlasticity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate experience-dependent changes in neural connections to learning and adaptation without claiming unlimited voluntary control.

##### Signalisation neuronale

[neuralSignaling.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/neuralCommunication/skills/neuralSignaling.data.ts)

[neurotransmitterAction.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/biologicalFoundationsOfBehavior/neuralCommunication/skills/neurotransmitterAction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain modulatory chemical signaling without the misleading claim that a single neurotransmitter directly causes one emotion.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi un seul neurotransmetteur ne détermine pas une émotion précise.

### Développement tout au long de la vie

Groups: 4 · Skills: 17

[developmentAcrossTheLifespan.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/developmentAcrossTheLifespan/developmentAcrossTheLifespan.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cognition, relationships, identity, and emotional regulation change from infancy through older adulthood. Developmental patterns express interactions of maturation and lived experience, not identical milestones for every person.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les personnes changent et s'adaptent de la petite enfance au grand âge.

### Émotions et régulation psychologique

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[emotionAndPsychologicalRegulation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/emotionAndPsychologicalRegulation/emotionAndPsychologicalRegulation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Emotional responses combine appraisal, bodily activation, expression, and action tendencies. Regulation concerns responding flexibly to emotions, not suppressing every uncomfortable experience.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment naissent les émotions, ce qu’elles nous indiquent et comment les réguler.

### Apprentissage et changement de comportement

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[learningAndBehaviorChange.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/learningAndBehaviorChange.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Past experience modifies responding through predictive cues, consequences, and social observation. This domain explains mechanisms of behavioral acquisition and flexibility rather than memory storage or a teaching sequence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l'expérience, les conséquences et l'observation modifient le comportement au fil du temps.

#### Apprentissage opérant

Skills: 6

[operantLearning.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/operantLearning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consequences influence the future frequency of actions; functional definitions depend on observed behavioral change rather than whether an outcome seems pleasant.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les récompenses et les conséquences influencent les comportements.

##### Punition négative

[negativePunishment.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/negativePunishment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the removal of a consequence followed by reduced future responding and distinguish it from negative reinforcement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand retirer quelque chose d'agréable diminue la fréquence d'un comportement.

##### Renforcement négatif

[negativeReinforcement.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/negativeReinforcement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a consequence removed after a behavior that increases future responding, without confusing removal with punishment.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment supprimer une situation désagréable peut renforcer un comportement.

##### Conditionnement opérant

[operantConditioning.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/operantConditioning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify behavior–consequence contingencies that alter future responding.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment les conséquences d'une action modifient sa probabilité de répétition.

##### Punition positive

[positivePunishment.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/positivePunishment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify an added consequence followed by a reduction in the future occurrence of a behavior.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand l'ajout d'une conséquence diminue la probabilité d'un comportement.

##### Renforcement positif

[positiveReinforcement.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/positiveReinforcement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a consequence added after a behavior that increases its future occurrence under the relevant conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand ajouter une conséquence souhaitable rend un comportement plus probable.

[reinforcementSchedules.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/reinforcementSchedules.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how timing and predictability of consequences alter response rates and persistence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment le moment et la fréquence des récompenses influencent l'apprentissage.

Skills: 6

[respondentConditioning.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/respondentConditioning/respondentConditioning.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les associations entre stimuli peuvent provoquer des réponses apprises.

[classicalConditioning.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/respondentConditioning/skills/classicalConditioning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify conditioned and unconditioned stimuli and responses within a learned predictive association.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment un signal initialement neutre peut déclencher une réponse apprise.

[conditionedResponseAcquisition.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/respondentConditioning/skills/conditionedResponseAcquisition.data.ts)

[spontaneousRecovery.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/respondentConditioning/skills/spontaneousRecovery.data.ts)

[stimulusDiscrimination.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/respondentConditioning/skills/stimulusDiscrimination.data.ts)

[observationalLearning.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/socialLearning/skills/observationalLearning.data.ts)

[vicariousReinforcement.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/socialLearning/skills/vicariousReinforcement.data.ts)

#### Transfert et flexibilité comportementale

Skills: 4

[transferAndBehavioralFlexibility.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/transferAndBehavioralFlexibility/transferAndBehavioralFlexibility.data.ts)

[contextDependentLearning.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/transferAndBehavioralFlexibility/skills/contextDependentLearning.data.ts)

[motivationalMechanisms.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/motivationalMechanisms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Behavior is influenced by internal states and external incentives, with competing explanations and substantial individual variation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre les différentes sources de motivation derrière les actions humaines.

##### Motivation d’approche

[approachMotivation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/approachMotivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain initiation of actions aimed at obtaining anticipated positive outcomes.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais la motivation à aller vers un résultat souhaité.

##### Motivation d’évitement

[avoidanceMotivation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/avoidanceMotivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain actions aimed at preventing or escaping an anticipated undesirable outcome.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais la motivation à éviter un résultat indésirable.

##### Attente et valeur

[expectancyAndValue.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/expectancyAndValue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how anticipated success and the perceived value of an outcome jointly influence effort.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi les attentes et la valeur perçue influencent les efforts.

##### Motivation extrinsèque

[extrinsicMotivation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/extrinsicMotivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain pursuing an activity because of an outcome separable from the activity, such as recognition, payment, or avoidance of a consequence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment récompenses et pressions extérieures influencent la motivation.

##### Motivation intrinsèque

[intrinsicMotivation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/intrinsicMotivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain engaging in an activity because it is personally interesting or satisfying in itself.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais l’envie de faire une activité pour la satisfaction qu’elle procure.

##### Effet d’éviction motivationnelle

[motivationalCrowding.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/motivationalCrowding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate circumstances in which external incentives change an existing interest rather than simply adding more motivation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi des récompenses externes diminuent parfois l’intérêt personnel.

##### Besoins et pulsions

[needsAndDrives.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/motivationGoalsAndHabits/motivationalMechanisms/skills/needsAndDrives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how physiological and psychological needs can influence the direction and intensity of behavior.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les besoins psychologiques et physiques façonnent le comportement.

### Personnalité et différences individuelles

Groups: 4 · Skills: 18

[personalityAndIndividualVariation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/personalityAndIndividualVariation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** People differ in characteristic patterns of thought, feeling, and behavior, but measurement requires caution about situations, cultural meaning, and fairness. Describing a tendency never fixes a person's worth or destiny.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment la personnalité et les capacités cognitives varient selon les personnes et les situations.

#### Différences cognitives et d'apprentissage

Skills: 5

[cognitiveAndLearningDifferences.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Performance varies across abilities, experiences, and testing contexts, with no one score capturing every capability.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore divers profils de points forts cognitifs et de besoins d'apprentissage.

##### Équité des évaluations cognitives

[fairnessInCognitiveAssessment.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences/skills/fairnessInCognitiveAssessment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify language, cultural, disability, and resource factors that can undermine an interpretation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment les tests cognitifs peuvent désavantager des personnes selon le contexte.

##### Profils cognitifs individuels

[individualCognitiveProfiles.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences/skills/individualCognitiveProfiles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret strengths and difficulties across different cognitive tasks without treating one performance as global ability.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les forces propres à chacun plutôt qu'une étiquette fixe de capacité.

##### Inné et acquis dans les capacités

[natureAndNurtureInAbility.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences/skills/natureAndNurtureInAbility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze interplay among heredity, learning opportunities, and environmental conditions in measured performance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment l'hérédité et l'environnement influencent ensemble les capacités.

##### Variabilité du neurodéveloppement

[neurodevelopmentalVariability.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences/skills/neurodevelopmentalVariability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences in developmental trajectories of attention, communication, sensory processing, and executive functions, accounting for the role of environment and support without treating variation itself as a disorder.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends que les différences de neurodéveloppement varient beaucoup d'une personne à l'autre.

##### Interprétation des scores standardisés

[standardizedScoreInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cognitiveAndLearningDifferences/skills/standardizedScoreInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain norm-referenced scores and why reference populations and test conditions matter.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète les scores standardisés en tenant compte des groupes de référence et des limites.

#### Culture et diversité

Skills: 4

[cultureAndDiversity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cultureAndDiversity/cultureAndDiversity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Human psychological patterns must be examined against differences in context, institutions, and ways of interpreting experience.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment la culture et la diversité influencent l'expérience psychologique.

##### Éviter l'essentialisme psychologique

[avoidingPsychologicalEssentialism.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cultureAndDiversity/skills/avoidingPsychologicalEssentialism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Challenge explanations that attribute complex traits to immutable characteristics of a social group.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Évite de considérer les moyennes d'un groupe comme des qualités psychologiques fixes de chaque personne.

##### Biais dans les normes psychologiques

[biasInPsychologicalNorms.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cultureAndDiversity/skills/biasInPsychologicalNorms.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how a reference sample can cause ordinary differences to be misclassified as deviations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les normes d'évaluation peuvent désavantager des personnes ou des groupes.

##### Comparabilité des recherches interculturelles

[crossCulturalResearchComparability.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cultureAndDiversity/skills/crossCulturalResearchComparability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate whether tasks and concepts carry comparable meaning across studied populations.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare des études psychologiques entre cultures sans supposer que les mesures sont identiques.

##### Variations culturelles du comportement

[culturalVariationInBehavior.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/cultureAndDiversity/skills/culturalVariationInBehavior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how norms and practices shape psychological expression without assuming uniformity within any culture.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais que le comportement peut varier selon les normes culturelles et les circonstances.

Skills: 4

[selfConceptAndIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/selfConceptAndIdentity/selfConceptAndIdentity.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les idées que les personnes ont d'elles-mêmes se développent et évoluent.

[identityAndSocialContext.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/selfConceptAndIdentity/skills/identityAndSocialContext.data.ts)

##### Concept de soi

[selfConcept.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/selfConceptAndIdentity/skills/selfConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how people organize beliefs about their characteristics, roles, and competencies.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends les idées et les caractéristiques qui composent la représentation de soi.

##### Estime de soi

[selfEsteem.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/selfConceptAndIdentity/skills/selfEsteem.data.ts)

[traitSituationInteraction.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/personalityAndIndividualVariation/traitsAndPersonalityModels/skills/traitSituationInteraction.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une tendance durable de personnalité d'un état temporaire.

### Science psychologique et démarche d’enquête

Groups: 5 · Skills: 31

[psychologicalScienceAndInquiry.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Psychology explains behavior and mental processes through empirical evidence, multiple levels of analysis, and ethical inquiry. Its explanations are provisional and require stronger support than anecdote or authority.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les psychologues étudient les comportements et les processus mentaux grâce à des recherches rigoureuses.

#### Preuves et interprétation

Skills: 6

[evidenceAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/evidenceAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Quantitative summaries and research transparency help discriminate robust patterns from noise and misleading causal stories.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les preuves et la transparence des analyses étayent les conclusions scientifiques.

##### Reproductibilité analytique

[analyticalReproducibility.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/analyticalReproducibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why access to reported methods, data, and analytic decisions allows independent verification of a result.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi des méthodes et des choix d’analyse clairement décrits permettent une vérification indépendante.

##### Variables de confusion

[confoundingVariables.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/confoundingVariables.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify background factors that move with a proposed cause and could produce an observed group difference.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère d’autres facteurs susceptibles d’expliquer une différence entre des groupes.

##### Corrélation et causalité

[correlationAndCausation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/correlationAndCausation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider reversed direction and third-variable explanations when two psychological measures vary together.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue une association de la preuve qu’un facteur psychologique en cause un autre.

##### Statistiques descriptives en recherche

[descriptiveStatisticsInResearch.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/descriptiveStatisticsInResearch.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret distributions, typical values, and variability without treating a group average as every participant's experience.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Interprète les valeurs typiques et les variations sans supposer que tout le monde correspond à la moyenne.

##### Qualité des preuves

[evidenceQuality.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/evidenceQuality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Weigh converging studies, effect magnitude, uncertainty, and publication bias instead of relying on one striking result.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les résultats de recherches selon leur solidité, leur incertitude et leurs biais possibles.

##### Réplication d’une étude

[studyReplication.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/evidenceAndInterpretation/skills/studyReplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why repeating a psychological investigation with new observations helps assess the robustness and generality of a result.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi répéter une étude aide à tester la solidité d’un résultat.

#### Fondements et perspectives

Skills: 4

[foundationsAndPerspectives.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/foundationsAndPerspectives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific accounts distinguish description, prediction, and causal explanation while combining cognitive, biological, behavioral, and sociocultural perspectives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre les différentes perspectives et les objectifs scientifiques de la psychologie.

##### Explication et prédiction

[explanationAndPrediction.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/explanationAndPrediction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate a description of observed behavior, a forecast about future behavior, and a proposed mechanism responsible for it.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la description d’un comportement de la prédiction ou de l’explication de ses causes.

##### Approches historiques de la psychologie

[historicalPsychologicalApproaches.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/historicalPsychologicalApproaches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate foundational schools of thought in their historical context and assess why some claims have been revised by later evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les premières théories psychologiques ont évolué avec l’amélioration des preuves.

##### Perspectives psychologiques

[psychologicalPerspectives.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/psychologicalPerspectives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare how behavioral, cognitive, biological, developmental, and sociocultural models explain different aspects of the same phenomenon.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare la manière dont différentes approches psychologiques expliquent un même comportement.

##### Champ de la science psychologique

[scopeOfPsychologicalScience.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/scopeOfPsychologicalScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the empirical study of behavior and experience from philosophical evaluation of arguments and from medical diagnosis or treatment.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la recherche en psychologie de la philosophie et des traitements cliniques.

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate whether repeated or equivalent measurements are consistent enough for their intended interpretation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Vérifie si une mesure psychologique donne des résultats cohérents.

[representativeSampling.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/skills/representativeSampling.data.ts)

Skills: 7

[researchEthics.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/researchEthics.data.ts)

[informedConsent.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/informedConsent.data.ts)

[researchConfidentiality.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchConfidentiality.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les chercheurs protègent les données identifiables des participants.

[researchDebriefing.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchDebriefing.data.ts)

##### Recherche auprès de personnes vulnérables

[researchWithVulnerableParticipants.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchWithVulnerableParticipants.data.ts)

##### Évaluation des risques et bénéfices

[riskBenefitAssessment.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/riskBenefitAssessment.data.ts)

##### Entretiens de recherche

[researchInterviews.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/studyDesigns/skills/researchInterviews.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret conversational accounts of experience while considering interviewer influence, recall limits, and unequal disclosure pressures.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore ce que les entretiens peuvent révéler et comment les questions influencent les réponses.

##### Hypothèses vérifiables

[researchableHypotheses.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/studyDesigns/skills/researchableHypotheses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Transform a broad statement about human behavior into a claim with observable variables and possible disconfirming evidence.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Transforme une affirmation courante sur le comportement en hypothèse que l’on peut étudier.

##### Observation systématique

[systematicObservation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/studyDesigns/skills/systematicObservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use predefined behavioral categories to distinguish structured observations from informal personal impressions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Consigne les comportements selon des règles d’observation constantes plutôt que tes impressions.

### Sensation et perception

Groups: 5 · Skills: 23

[sensationAndPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensationAndPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sensory information is detected, selected, organized, and interpreted into an experienced world. Psychological perception differs from simple measurement of physical stimuli or anatomy of sense organs.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les signaux sensoriels deviennent des expériences du monde qui nous entoure.

#### Sens corporels et chimiques

Skills: 6

[bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Touch, pain, balance, body position, smell, and taste rely on partly distinct receptor and processing pathways. Their psychological importance lies in how signals become conscious experiences and guide action, not in cataloguing anatomy alone.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment le toucher, la douleur, l’odorat, le goût et les sens corporels guident notre expérience.

##### Perception de la douleur

[painPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/painPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how nociceptive input, context, attention, and expectations interact in the experience of pain, without equating its intensity with a single tissue measurement.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi la douleur dépend de plus d’un seul signal provenant des tissus.

##### Proprioception

[proprioception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/proprioception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how information about muscle and joint state supports awareness of limb position and movement even without vision.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment ton corps perçoit la position de tes membres sans regarder.

##### Perception olfactive

[smellPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/smellPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how patterns of odorant stimulation contribute to identifying smells and why learning, adaptation, and context can alter odor judgments.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment l’expérience passée et le contexte influencent l’identification des odeurs.

##### Perception gustative

[tastePerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/tastePerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gustatory information supports basic taste qualities and interacts with smell and other sensory cues in experienced flavor.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment le goût et l’odorat s’associent pour former les saveurs.

##### Perception tactile

[touchPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/touchPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how contact, pressure, vibration, and texture are discriminated through somatosensory processing, and why perceived touch depends on stimulus location and context.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment la pression et les vibrations deviennent une sensation de toucher.

##### Perception vestibulaire

[vestibularPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/vestibularPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how sensed head motion and orientation contribute to balance and spatial perception, including interactions with vision and proprioception.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique comment les mouvements et l’orientation de la tête aident à garder l’équilibre.

#### Illusions et perception multisensorielle

Skills: 4

[illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception/illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Systematic distortions and interactions across senses reveal how perception infers likely causes of stimulation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre ce que les illusions sensorielles révèlent sur le fonctionnement de la perception.

##### Intégration entre les sens

[crossModalIntegration.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception/skills/crossModalIntegration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how combined sensory cues can modify a percept compared with cues considered separately.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment des indices venant de sens différents modifient une même expérience.

##### Perception des témoins oculaires

[eyewitnessPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception/skills/eyewitnessPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the effects of attention, conditions, and later interpretation on the reliability of witnessed events.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Réfléchis aux limites des observations de témoins dans des conditions distrayantes.

##### Attentes perceptives

[perceptualExpectations.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception/skills/perceptualExpectations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze the influence of prior knowledge or priming while distinguishing interpretation from the actual stimulus.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand des connaissances antérieures changent l’interprétation d’un stimulus inchangé.

##### Illusions visuelles

[visualIllusions.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/illusionsAndMultisensoryPerception/skills/visualIllusions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how contextual cues create reliable differences between an object's measured property and its appearance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi une illusion visuelle peut différer d’une caractéristique physique mesurée.

#### Organisation perceptive

Skills: 4

[perceptualOrganization.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/perceptualOrganization/perceptualOrganization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The mind uses grouping cues and expectations to construct coherent objects from ambiguous sensory input.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l’esprit regroupe les informations sensorielles en objets reconnaissables.

##### Traitement ascendant et descendant

[bottomUpAndTopDownProcessing.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/perceptualOrganization/skills/bottomUpAndTopDownProcessing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish stimulus-driven evidence from prior expectations and explain their interaction in perception.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les attentes et les sensations reçues façonnent ensemble la perception.

##### Organisation figure–fond

[figureGroundOrganization.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/perceptualOrganization/skills/figureGroundOrganization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how context changes which part of a scene is experienced as a foreground object.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les éléments d’une scène qui semblent au premier plan ou à l’arrière-plan.

##### Regroupement gestaltiste

[gestaltGrouping.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/perceptualOrganization/skills/gestaltGrouping.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply similarity, proximity, closure, and continuity to explain grouping of visible elements.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Utilise la proximité, la similarité et la continuité pour expliquer les regroupements visuels.

##### Constance perceptive

[perceptualConstancy.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/perceptualOrganization/skills/perceptualConstancy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain relatively stable perceived size, shape, or color across changing sensory conditions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi taille, forme ou couleur peuvent paraître stables malgré des conditions changeantes.

#### Détection sensorielle

Skills: 5

[sensoryDetection.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensoryDetection/sensoryDetection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sensitivity depends on stimulus intensity, adaptation, and detection conditions rather than a perfectly fixed threshold.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment l’intensité d’un stimulus et ses conditions influencent sa détection.

##### Seuils de détection

[detectionThresholds.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensoryDetection/skills/detectionThresholds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how signal strength and competing noise affect the likelihood of noticing a stimulus.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explique pourquoi les signaux plus forts sont parfois plus faciles à remarquer dans le bruit.

##### Seuils différentiels

[differenceThresholds.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensoryDetection/skills/differenceThresholds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the detectable difference between stimuli to their starting intensity and context.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand une différence entre deux stimuli devient perceptible.

##### Différence entre sensation et perception

[sensationVersusPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensoryDetection/skills/sensationVersusPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish sensory encoding of stimulation from the interpretation of what that stimulation represents.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue la détection d’un stimulus de l’interprétation de son sens.

##### Adaptation sensorielle

[sensoryAdaptation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensoryDetection/skills/sensoryAdaptation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe changed sensitivity after sustained stimulation without mistaking it for change in the source.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment la sensibilité peut changer après une exposition constante à un stimulus.

##### Transduction sensorielle

[sensoryTransduction.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensoryDetection/skills/sensoryTransduction.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how sensory receptors transform light, mechanical stimulation, or chemical signals into neural activity, distinguishing this initial encoding from later perception.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les récepteurs sensoriels transforment les stimulations en signaux nerveux.

#### Expérience visuelle et auditive

Skills: 4

[visualAndAuditoryExperience.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/visualAndAuditoryExperience/visualAndAuditoryExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Spatial, chromatic, and speech experiences emerge from interpreting patterns of visual or acoustic information.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment nous interprétons les formes visuelles et les sons.

##### Perception des couleurs

[colorPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/visualAndAuditoryExperience/skills/colorPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate wavelengths, relative context, and neural processing to perceived colors without equating color with one wavelength.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi la couleur perçue dépend du contexte et du traitement neuronal.

##### Perception de la profondeur

[depthPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/visualAndAuditoryExperience/skills/depthPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the contributions of binocular and monocular cues to estimating distance.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les indices visuels qui aident à estimer la distance d’un objet.

##### Localisation sonore

[soundLocalization.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/visualAndAuditoryExperience/skills/soundLocalization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how timing and level differences between ears contribute to perceived sound direction.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment les différences entre les deux oreilles aident à localiser un son.

##### Perception de la parole

[speechPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/visualAndAuditoryExperience/skills/speechPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how acoustic cues, noise, and language expectations shape understanding of spoken messages.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment les sons et les attentes linguistiques influencent la compréhension de la parole.

### Psychologie sociale

Groups: 4 · Skills: 24

[socialPsychology.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPsychology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Thought and behavior change in the actual or imagined presence of others. Social processes involve interpretation, group membership, influence, and relationships without assuming all people respond alike.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les autres influencent nos croyances, nos actions et nos relations.

#### Dynamique de groupe

Skills: 5

[groupDynamics.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/groupDynamics/groupDynamics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Belonging and coordination can alter performance, responsibility, intergroup attitudes, and collective decisions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment identités collectives et discussions façonnent le comportement.

##### Effet du témoin

[bystanderEffect.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/groupDynamics/skills/bystanderEffect.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how others' presence can change perceived responsibility or interpretations of a situation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi les gens hésitent parfois à aider lorsque d’autres sont présents.

##### Polarisation de groupe

[groupPolarization.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/groupDynamics/skills/groupPolarization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how discussion among similarly inclined people can shift collective judgments toward more extreme positions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi une discussion peut rendre les positions communes plus extrêmes.

##### Pensée de groupe

[groupthink.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/groupDynamics/skills/groupthink.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify pressures toward unanimity that discourage dissent and reduce the scrutiny of alternatives.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand la pression à l’accord empêche une évaluation critique.

##### Biais envers son groupe et les autres groupes

[inGroupAndOutGroupBias.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/groupDynamics/skills/inGroupAndOutGroupBias.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze unequal evaluation of people based on group membership even without direct personal experience.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais la préférence injustifiée pour son propre groupe.

##### Identité sociale

[socialIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/groupDynamics/skills/socialIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how membership in meaningful groups contributes to self-description and intergroup interpretation.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment l’appartenance à un groupe influence l’identité sociale.

#### Influence et persuasion

Skills: 6

[influenceAndPersuasion.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/influenceAndPersuasion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Other people's behavior, claims, and group norms can shift beliefs or actions through identifiable social mechanisms.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment les groupes, l’autorité et les messages influencent les choix.

##### Conformisme

[conformity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/skills/conformity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain changes in expressed judgments or behavior under perceived group pressure.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais les changements de comportement pour correspondre aux attentes du groupe.

##### Influence sociale informationnelle

[informationalSocialInfluence.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/skills/informationalSocialInfluence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain adopting others' judgments when they appear to provide useful evidence about uncertainty.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends quand l’information donnée par les autres guide nos décisions.

##### Influence sociale normative

[normativeSocialInfluence.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/skills/normativeSocialInfluence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain compliance motivated by social approval or avoidance of rejection.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais quand le désir de s’intégrer à un groupe change le comportement.

##### Obéissance à l’autorité

[obedienceToAuthority.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/skills/obedienceToAuthority.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how authority cues and situational pressures influence compliance, including ethical limits of classic research.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore pourquoi l’autorité influence les décisions sans garantir qu’elles soient justes.

##### Voies de la persuasion

[persuasionRoutes.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/skills/persuasionRoutes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare careful evaluation of arguments with reliance on source or presentation cues.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Compare les voies par lesquelles les messages persuasifs changent les attitudes.

##### Reconnaître la manipulation psychologique

[recognizingPsychologicalManipulation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/influenceAndPersuasion/skills/recognizingPsychologicalManipulation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify exploitative uses of urgency, isolation, guilt, or unequal power without teaching techniques to manipulate others.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère les tactiques de pression qui exploitent peur, culpabilité ou attentes sociales.

#### Relations et communication

Skills: 7

[relationshipsAndCommunication.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/relationshipsAndCommunication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relationships develop through mutual interpretation, reciprocal actions, boundaries, and social context rather than perfect reading of another's intentions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Apprends à reconnaître une communication saine, des limites personnelles et des défis relationnels.

##### Écoute active

[activeListening.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/activeListening.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish checking understanding and attending to another person's meaning from merely waiting to reply.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Entraîne-toi à écouter attentivement et à clarifier ce que l’autre exprime.

##### Attachement dans les relations

[attachmentInRelationships.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/attachmentInRelationships.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how expectations about availability and support can influence close relationships while avoiding rigid labeling of individuals.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les styles d’attachement influencent les relations au fil du temps.

##### Conflit interpersonnel

[interpersonalConflict.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/interpersonalConflict.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how unmet expectations, differing interpretations, communication patterns, and situational pressures contribute to the emergence or escalation of disagreements between people.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les désaccords s’aggravent et comment les résoudre de façon constructive.

##### Communication non verbale

[nonverbalCommunication.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/nonverbalCommunication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret gesture, tone, and interpersonal distance in cultural and situational context rather than through universal decoding rules.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment le visage, les gestes et le ton de voix transmettent des informations.

##### Limites personnelles

[personalBoundaries.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/personalBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how individuals express limits about interactions, information, and bodily or emotional space, and how those limits merit respect.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Identifie les limites qu’une personne fixe concernant son corps, son temps et ses informations.

##### Réparer une relation

[relationshipRepair.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/relationshipRepair.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how acknowledgment, apology, changed behavior, and negotiated expectations can help restore trust after interpersonal harm without assuming reconciliation is always safe or obligatory.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends ce qui aide à rétablir la confiance après un désaccord.

##### Consentement libre

[voluntaryConsent.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/relationshipsAndCommunication/skills/voluntaryConsent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish an informed, freely given and revocable agreement from silence, coercion, or assumed permission.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends que le consentement doit être libre et peut être retiré.

#### Perception sociale

Skills: 6

[socialPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/socialPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judgments about other people are inferred from limited evidence and shaped by expectations, roles, and context.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment nous interprétons les actions, intentions et sentiments des autres.

##### Compassion

[compassion.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/skills/compassion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain concern for another person's suffering accompanied by motivation to offer appropriate help, distinct from understanding alone.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Distingue le souci bienveillant d’autrui du simple fait de comprendre ses sentiments.

##### Empathie

[empathy.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/skills/empathy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain understanding or affectively responding to another person's possible experience while recognizing that one cannot know it with certainty.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends l’empathie comme la reconnaissance et le partage partiel du vécu d’autrui.

##### Premières impressions

[firstImpressions.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/skills/firstImpressions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how early information can disproportionately influence expectations about a person.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais comment se forment les premières impressions et pourquoi elles peuvent tromper.

##### Prise de perspective

[perspectiveTaking.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/skills/perspectiveTaking.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain inferring another person's possible viewpoint while recognizing that their actual experience remains uncertain.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Entraîne-toi à considérer une situation du point de vue d’une autre personne.

##### Attribution sociale

[socialAttribution.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/skills/socialAttribution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish explanations invoking a person's dispositions from those emphasizing circumstances and available choices.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends comment on déduit les causes du comportement d’autrui.

##### Activation des stéréotypes

[stereotypeActivation.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/socialPsychology/socialPerception/skills/stereotypeActivation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how culturally available categories affect social perception without treating stereotypes as reliable descriptions.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Explore comment les stéréotypes influencent les jugements avant une réflexion consciente.

### Pensée et prise de décision

Groups: 5 · Skills: 27

[thinkingAndDecisionMaking.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/thinkingAndDecisionMaking.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cognitive processes create concepts, guide inferences, solve problems, and select actions under limited information. The focus is what people actually do, not whether their reasoning satisfies a formal philosophical standard.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment on forme des concepts, résout des problèmes et prend des décisions imparfaites.

#### Choix en situation d'incertitude

Skills: 5

[choicesUnderUncertainty.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/choicesUnderUncertainty/choicesUnderUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Decisions depend on reference points, delayed consequences, uncertainty, and how alternatives are presented.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre comment l'incertitude, les probabilités et la présentation des informations influencent les choix.

##### Négligence des taux de base

[baseRateNeglect.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/choicesUnderUncertainty/skills/baseRateNeglect.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain failures to incorporate prior frequencies when a compelling individual example is present.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Repère quand les personnes négligent les fréquences de référence dans leurs jugements.

##### Architecture des choix

[choiceArchitecture.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/choicesUnderUncertainty/skills/choiceArchitecture.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how defaults, option ordering, and information load shift behavior without assuming every nudge is harmless.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Observe comment les options par défaut et l'ordre des choix peuvent influencer les décisions.

##### Dévalorisation liée au délai

[delayDiscounting.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/choicesUnderUncertainty/skills/delayDiscounting.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain changing subjective value of an outcome as its delivery becomes more distant.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Découvre pourquoi une récompense lointaine peut être moins valorisée qu'une récompense immédiate.

##### Aversion aux pertes

[lossAversion.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/choicesUnderUncertainty/skills/lossAversion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a loss relative to a reference point may carry greater subjective weight than an equivalent gain.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Comprends pourquoi les pertes peuvent sembler plus importantes que des gains équivalents.

##### Perception du risque

[riskPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/thinkingAndDecisionMaking/choicesUnderUncertainty/skills/riskPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze why vividness, familiarity, controllability, and dread affect judgments of risk.

**User-friendly description (fr):** Reconnais que le danger ressenti ne dépend pas seulement des probabilités statistiques.
